title: Bitcoin balances $60K tightrope as US stocks rebound on fresh Iran peace deal hopes
summary: Bitcoin faced its own battle for support as US stocks headed higher and analysts warned of a lack of "conviction" among BTC buyers.

title: Coinbase, Kraken and OKX move to swoop up EU users affected by MiCA restrictions
summary: Several exchanges that have already been authorized by EU regulators are attempting to bring in users from companies unlicensed under the Markets in Crypto-Assets rules, offering transfer bonuses and prizes.

title: BNY adds USDC minting and redemption to institutional custody platform
summary: The move deepens BNY's partnership with Circle and builds on the bank's role as the primary custodian of USDC reserves.

title: Can AI drain DeFi? Separating Claude Mythos hype from reality
summary: Claude Mythos has raised concerns about AI-driven attacks on DeFi protocols. However, the same AI tools are also available to security teams, not just attackers.

title: From Bitcoin critics to blockchain believers: The 5 biggest crypto backflips
summary: If you can't beat 'em, join 'em. Here are five crypto skeptics who have reluctantly embraced the opportunity of making loads of money with blockchain.

title: Strategy unveils capital framework to preserve Bitcoin exposure, pay dividends
summary: Michael Saylor’s Strategy unveiled a capital framework allowing Bitcoin sales to fund dividends, a $2.55 billion reserve and buybacks while raising STRC payout to 12%.

title: Breez launches Bitcoin-to-stablecoin payments across more than 30 blockchains
summary: The new SDK feature lets developers route payments from Bitcoin balances to recipients in USDC and USDT without requiring users to hold stablecoins.

title: Prediction-market operational consolidation could spur M&A wave: Bernstein
summary: Bernstein says platforms are bringing exchange, clearing and brokerage infrastructure in-house, setting up potential deals while increasing antitrust and regulatory risks.

title: Vitalik Buterin says obfuscation could unlock private onchain crypto voting
summary: Vitalik Buterin said indistinguishability obfuscation could eventually support private, collusion-resistant onchain voting without trusted committees, though the technology remains impractical.

title: Germany leads MiCA crypto authorization race as Europe’s deadline looms
summary: MiCA crypto licensing data shows 244 approved companies across EU and EEA jurisdictions, led by Germany with France and the Netherlands also among top hubs ahead of July 1 cliff.
